SECTION ONE
Purpose, Scope, Basis and Definitions
Purpose:
ARTICLE 1- (1) The purpose of this directive is to regulate the functioning, operations, procedures, and principles
in terms of planning, exe cution, and evaluation processes of the GTU Accessibility Division, which has been
established to facilitate the learning experience of students with disabilities that study at Gebze Technical University,
to ensure the preparation of the necessary academic environment, to take the necessary measures to ensure their full
participation in the education and teaching processes, and also to facilitate the lives of the university employees with
disabilities on campus.
Scope:
ARTICLE 2 - (1) This directive covers the provisions regarding the structure, function, operation, duties , and
responsibilities of the "GTU Accessibility Division" established within Gebze Technical University.
Basis:
ARTICLE 3- (1) This Directive is based on Article 15 of the "Law on Disabled People and on Making Amendments
to Some Laws and Decree Laws" dated 01/07/2005 and numbered 5378,
(2) Article 11 of the " Regulation on Consultation and Coordination for Disabled People at Higher Education
Institutions" published in the Official Gazette No. 27672 dated 14/08/2010,
(3) Provisions of the "Regulation on Making Amendments to the Regulation on Consultation and Coordination for
Disabled People at Higher Education Institutions", which came into force after being published in the Official Gazette
dated 03/01/2013 and numbered 28517.
Definitions:
ARTICLE 4- People who have difficulties in adapting to social life and meeting their daily needs due to losing their
physical, mental, spiritual, emotional, and social abilities to various degrees due to any reason, congenital or acquired,
and who need protection, care, rehabilitation, consultancy and support services, and those who are in need of
protection, care, rehabilitation, con sultancy, and support services are defined as people with disabilities; thus, the
following terms in this Directive have the following definitions:
a) Student with disabilities: Gebze Technical University student
b) Employee with disabilities: Gebze Technical University employee with disabilities
c) University: Gebze Technical University
d) Rector: Rector of Gebze Technical University
d) Relevant D irectorate: Directorate of Health, Culture and Sports, D irectorate of Student Affairs , and
Directorate of Construction and Technical Works
e) Executive Committee: The committee, which is under the responsibility and chairpersonship of the Vice-
Rector responsible for education and teaching affairs and consists of the Director of Health, Culture and Sports,
Director of Construction and Technical Works, Director of Student Affairs, the coordinator specialized in the
field of disabilities or in a field similar to the field of special education, representatives designated by Faculties
and Institutes
f) Representative: Student representative with disabilities selected from among the students with disabilities
SECTION TWO
Duties and Governing Bodies of the GTU Accessibility Division
Bodies:
ARTICLE 5 – (1) Bodies of the GTU Accessibility Division:
a) GTU Accessibility Division Executive Committee
b) GTU Accessibility Division Coordinator and Representative

Executive Committee
ARTICLE 6 - (1) Under the responsibility and chairmanship of the Vice -Rector responsible for education and
teaching, it consists of the Director of Health, Culture and Sports, the Director of Student Affairs , the Director of
Construction and Technical Works , 1 representative each selected from among administrators or academics
designated by the Faculties and Institutes, and the GTU Accessibility Division Coordinator, who has specialized in
the field of people with disabilities or has expertise in areas close to the field of special education.
(2) Committee members are assigned by the Rector for a term of 3 years. Members whose term of office has expired
may be reassigned. In place of the member who leaves before the end of his/her term, a new member with the same
status is assigned to complete the remaining term.
(3) The Executive Committee meets by absolute majority upon the invitation of the Vice -Rector and decisions are
taken by majority vote.
(4) When necessary, relevant persons from the relevant administrative and academic divisions and student
representatives may be invited to the meetings of the executive committee.
GTU Accessibility Division Representative:
ARTICLE 7- (1) A representative student with disabilities who will conduct activities for the GTU Accessibility
Division is assigned to represent the students with disabilities studying at the university.
GTU Accessibility Division
ARTICLE 8 - (1) At GTU Accessibility Division , u nder the responsibility of the executive committee, a staff
member of the Directorate of Health, Culture and Sports to assist the coordinator, to communicate with the students
visiting the division , and to work in coordination with the relevant directorates, faculty and institute division
representatives and a secretary to carry out secretarial duties serve.
Duties of the GTU Accessibility Division
ARTICLE 9- (1) The duties of the GTU Accessibility Division are stated below:
a) To identify the needs of students with disabilities enrolled at the u niversity regarding education,
scholarships, administrative, physical, housing, social, and similar areas while they follow their studies; to determine
the measures that need to be taken to meet th ese needs and to offer suggestions for solutions to eliminate them; to
make arrangements in coordination with other divisions or departments at the university
b) To work on the adaptation of the educational environment to the needs of the students with disabilities,
to provide equipment, to prepare special course materials, and to arrange appropriate education, research , and
accommodation environments in order to organize the education programs in a way that does not hinder the
academic, physical, and social lives of students with disabilities
c) To carry out publication activities for stude nts and faculty members at the university; to prepare
informative documents for faculty members explaining the special needs of the student and the limitations they bring,
and the arrangements that need to be made; to increase the level of awareness; to provide consultancy services for
those concerned; and to ensure in-service training when necessary
d) To develop programs and projects, organize seminars, conferences, and similar activities to increase the
level of awareness and sensitivity about students with disabilities
e) To prepare and execute the work program of the GTU Accessibility Division, to determine the budget
needs for the activities , and to prepare the annual activity report and submit it to the Vice -Rector with whom it is
affiliated
f) To create the division’s page and be easily accessible on the official w ebsite of the u niversity, which
includes publications, documents , and information for the parties on issues falling within the scope of duty and
activity of the GTU Accessibility Division , which enables students with disabilities studying at the university to
express their problems and wishes and allows them to communicate with the relevant division
g) To supervise the implementation of the decisions taken and the strategies determined

h) To work towards the free supply of auxiliary equipment for students with disabilities and financial
difficulties
i) To ensure the equality of opportunity and to make the education process meaningful for students with
disabilities; to provide the student with disabilities time, space, materials, and accompanying readers for the exams
and to provide appropriate information according to the differences arising from the student's special needs; to take
necessary precautions and make arrangements in order to ensure that all students are measured and evaluated fairly
and accurately
j) To take measures to ensure that works are carried out on the preparation of informative books on
employment opportunities and professions and that these are delivered to students with disabilities
k) To identify students with disabilities who have been placed in the university’s programs during their
enrollment in the university
l) To ensure that the university campus, the buildings, and the open areas on the campus are accessible to
students with disabilities
m) To encourage students with disabilities to become members of student societies and participate in
activities
n) To organize social responsibility projects that will enable our volunteer students to support students with
disabilities and to create a student support pool
o) To assign students with disabilities to duties in order to improve their sense of self -confidence and
competence in events such as the spring festival organization, university promotion events, and university graduation
ceremony held at the university
p) To support students with disabilities who have difficulty in meeting their financial needs to work part -
time, if the conditions are deemed necessary
q) To monitor every year the notification of the activity and evaluation report to the Presidency of the
Council of Higher Education that is submitted to the Rectorate
SECTION THREE
Miscellaneous Provisions
Quorum
Article 10- The executive committee is formed by absolute majority and takes decisions by majority vote.
Meeting Procedures and Principles
Article 11 GTU Accessibility Division Coordinator must personally meet with students with disabilities and evaluate
their situation once every semester.
GTU Accessibility Division Executive Committee Meeting is held at the beginning of each semester b y
the Vice-Rector who heads the Division. Other members of the GTU Accessibility Division may also request a
meeting invitation from the Vice-Rector, providing justification.
Additional Article (1)
Procedures and Principles Regarding Course and Exam Practices of Students with Disabilities
(1) Three classrooms, each with a large TV screen, computer, sound system and braille keyboard, have been created
for our visually-impaired, hearing-impaired, and color blind students.
(2) Upon the requests of our visually -impaired, hearing -impaired, and color blind students, depe nding on their
disability, the l ecturer will be present in the class es during the lectures and the l ecturer will be present in t he
classrooms during the exams, or an officer or researcher will be assigned.

Repealed Directive
Article 12 - The Work ing Procedures and Principles for the Disabled Students Division, dated 24/12/2014 and
numbered 2014/44, adopted by the Executive Board of Gebze Technical University, have been abolished.
Miscellaneous Provisions
Article 13- Relevant legislative provisions shall apply to all matters not covered in this Directive.
Article 14- This Directive enters into force on the date of its acceptance by the Senate of Gebze Technical University.
Article 15- This Directive is executed by the Rector of Gebze Technical University.
